description.value: Chase Groceteria is a convenience and grocery store located in Chase, a small town in BC's Thompson-Nicola region along the South Thompson River corridor. Situated on Second Avenue in the town centre, it serves as a resupply point for touring cyclists travelling the Trans-Canada Highway route between Kamloops and Shuswap Lake. Its 'Groceteria' name reflects the traditional BC general-store format common in small Interior communities.
